activities.name: Kuta Beach Surf Lesson
activities.description: Kuta's gentle breaking waves have taught more first-timers to surf than anywhere in Asia. A 2-hour lesson with a local instructor on a foam longboard — most people stand up by the end. All equipment included.

activities.name: Tanah Lot Sunset
activities.description: A Hindu sea temple perched on a black rock outcrop 300m offshore — one of Bali's most photographed images. Accessible on foot at low tide. The sunset is spectacular and arrives reliably. 20km from Seminyak.

activities.name: Campuhan Ridge Walk
activities.description: A 9km ridge path above Ubud through tall alang-alang grasslands — the most peaceful walk near the city. Start at dawn before tour groups arrive, end at Cafe Pomegranate for breakfast with a valley view.

activities.name: Tirta Empul Holy Spring
activities.description: Bali's most sacred water temple — a 962 AD spring complex where Balinese Hindus purify themselves in 22 numbered spouts. Visitors may enter the bathing pools with a sarong (provided). Arrive by 8am.

activities.name: Ubud Sacred Monkey Forest
activities.description: A 12-hectare Hindu sanctuary and nature reserve inside Ubud's urban core, inhabited by over 1,000 long-tailed macaques. Three temples, ancient banyan trees, and a holy spring. Keep your sunglasses in your bag.

activities.name: Potato Head Beach Club
activities.description: Seminyak's most iconic beach club — a Greco-inspired walled garden, three pools, and a DJ set that runs sunset to midnight. Book a day bed in advance. The cocktail menu is serious; so is the crowd.

activities.name: La Favela
activities.description: Seminyak's most atmospheric bar — a sprawling Victorian mansion draped in tropical plants and vintage artefacts. Multiple rooms and courtyards, each with a different sound. Free entry until 11pm.

activities.name: Locavore — Ubud Fine Dining
activities.description: Consistently Asia's 50 Best Restaurants list. Entirely Indonesian-sourced ingredients prepared with precision technique — the antithesis of tourist food. Book 2–3 months in advance. Dinner only; 7-course tasting menu.

activities.name: Warung Made
activities.description: The most reliable nasi campur (mixed rice) in Seminyak since 1969. A dozen rotating dishes displayed in clay pots — pick five, served over steamed white rice. Packed by noon, empty by 2pm — lunch only.

activities.name: Naughty Nuri's
activities.description: Ubud's legendary BBQ ribs warung — fall-off-the-bone pork ribs smoked over coconut husks, served with rice, salad, and a very strong martini. Queue outside (no reservations); cash only; always worth it.

activities.name: Four Seasons Jimbaran Bay
activities.description: Private-pool villas descending the Jimbaran hillside directly onto a white sand beach. Balinese architecture with Four Seasons precision — pavilion-style rooms, outdoor bathtubs, and a spa using local Jamu ingredients.

activities.name: COMO Uma Canggu
activities.description: A design-forward hotel right on Canggu's surf break — pool facing the ocean, the COMO Beach Club below. Minimalist Balinese architecture, the COMO Shambhala wellness programme, and Canggu's best beach access.

activities.name: The Yoga Barn
activities.description: Ubud's most established yoga and wellness centre — multiple studios, daily classes from sunrise to evening, meditation, sound healing, and a raw-food café. Drop-in classes from Rp130,000. No booking required.

activities.name: Ayung River White-Water Rafting
activities.description: A 2-hour Grade 2–3 rafting run through the Ayung River gorge north of Ubud — jungle-clad walls, rice terraces overhead, carved stone temple reliefs emerging from the riverbank. All equipment and transfer included.

activities.name: Pura Besakih — Mother Temple
activities.description: Bali's most sacred temple complex on the slopes of Mount Agung — a cluster of 23 separate temples stretching 900m up the volcano. Sarong and sash required (rental on-site). Best visited mid-week to avoid crowds.
